directAnswer: Transfer WhatsApp from Android to iPhone using the 'Move to iOS' app during the iPhone setup. Ensure both devices are on the same Wi-Fi network and fully charged.
summary: Transferring WhatsApp from Android to iPhone can be efficiently done using the Move to iOS app, which helps preserve your chat history and media files.

sections.heading: Using Move to iOS App
sections.body: The Move to iOS app facilitates the transfer of WhatsApp data during the initial setup of your new iPhone. Both devices must be connected to the same Wi-Fi network and have sufficient battery life.

sections.heading: Exporting Chat History via Email
sections.body: While you can export individual chat histories via email from your Android device, note that these cannot be imported back into WhatsApp on your iPhone.

steps.title: Prepare Your Devices
steps.detail: Ensure both your Android and iPhone are fully charged and connected to the same Wi-Fi network.

steps.title: Install Move to iOS
steps.detail: Download the Move to iOS app on your Android device from the Google Play Store.

steps.title: Start iPhone Setup
steps.detail: Turn on your new iPhone and follow the setup instructions until you reach the 'Apps & Data' screen.

steps.title: Transfer Data
steps.detail: Open the Move to iOS app on your Android device, follow the on-screen instructions, and select WhatsApp data to transfer.

steps.title: Export Chats via Email
steps.detail: Open a chat in WhatsApp on your Android, tap on the three dots, select 'More', then 'Export chat', and choose email to send the chat history.

faqs.question: Will I lose my chat history during the transfer?
faqs.answer: No, using the Move to iOS app should successfully transfer your chat history.

faqs.question: Can I transfer media files too?
faqs.answer: Yes, the Move to iOS app transfers media files along with your chat history.

faqs.question: Is there a limit to the number of chats I can transfer?
faqs.answer: There is no specific limit, but transferring a large number of chats may take more time.

caveats: The Move to iOS method requires both devices to be on the same Wi-Fi network and may not work if either device has a low battery.
Ensure that your Android device is running Android 5.0 or later and your iPhone is running iOS 15.5 or later for compatibility.
